panels.title: Est. Cost
panels.description: Haiku: $0.80/$4 · Sonnet: $3/$15 · Opus: $15/$75 per 1M in/out tokens

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "waterworks")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "input_tokens" or r._field == "output_tokens")
  |> toFloat()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value:
      if strings.containsStr(v: r.model, substr: "haiku") and r._field == "input_tokens" then r._value * 0.80 / 1000000.0
      else if strings.containsStr(v: r.model, substr: "haiku") and r._field == "output_tokens" then r._value * 4.0 / 1000000.0
      else if strings.containsStr(v: r.model, substr: "opus") and r._field == "input_tokens" then r._value * 15.0 / 1000000.0
      else if strings.containsStr(v: r.model, substr: "opus") and r._field == "output_tokens" then r._value * 75.0 / 1000000.0
      else if r._field == "input_tokens" then r._value * 3.0 / 1000000.0
      else r._value * 15.0 / 1000000.0
  }))
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Token Usage per Turn
panels.description: Each point is one AI turn. In multi-agent mode, series are labeled by agent role (intake, treatment, distribution, historian, orchestrator).

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "waterworks")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "input_tokens")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "in:" + strings.substring(v: r.session_id, start: 0, end: 8), role: if r.specialist == "" then "single" else r.specialist, model: r.model}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "role"])
  |> yield(name: "input_tokens")

panels.title: Specialist Latency
panels.description: Latency per specialist call over time. Orchestrator is typically slowest (synthesis). Specialists run in parallel so their wall-clock time overlaps.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waterworks")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.specialist != "")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.specialist}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "specialist_latency")
